title: HyperMix: open detection of engineered biosignatures in remote hyperspectral imagery
description: An open benchmark toolkit for detecting engineered biosignatures in remote hyperspectral imagery, with calibrated uncertainty. It includes a physics-based simulator, implanted-target benchmarks on real airborne backgrounds, classical baselines and learned models. In the completed experiments, no learned method robustly outperforms a well-calibrated spatial matched filter. Evaluation on physically measured bioHSI targets is paused pending recovery of the manual Figure 4g coordinates. Developed under the Experiment Foundation Hyperspectral Biology grant.
